upstream.description: This GitHub repo is a powerhouse collection of APIs you can start using immediately to build everything from simple automations to full-scale applications. One of the most valuable API lists on GitHub—period. 💪

classification.analysis: A large curated directory of public and commercial APIs organized by category (AI, automation, e-commerce, real estate, social media, MCP servers, etc.), each with its own README describing what the API does and how to access it. It's aimed at developers and builders looking for a starting point to wire up integrations or automations quickly rather than researching APIs from scratch. Mostly markdown content with a few JS scripts for generating/validating the listings.

use_cases.title: Find an API for a specific automation or integration task
Browse MCP-server-compatible APIs for agent tooling
Source APIs for lead-gen, scraping, or real-estate projects
